Winter break · For coaches

Coaches Clinic 2026

Two days on the floor at our December camp with Tremaine Dalton. Learn it, then coach it in the games.
  • 2 days
  • On court with real players
  • You coach a team in the games
  • Feedback after every game
  • Led by Deng and Tremaine Dalton
  • Session plans to take home
  • A full game day on Wednesday
  • Lunch on Tuesday
  • The camp t-shirt
Who
Coaches from any club, any level
Days
Two days. Tuesday 29 and Wednesday 30 December
Time
09:15 to 15:00
Where
Hafnia-Hallen, Julius Andersensvej 6, 2450 København SV
Places
30
Price
1.500 kr to Sunday 15 November, then 1.995 kr
Book a seat

The two days

Tuesday 29 is teaching day.

09:15
Coffee and the day's session plan
09:30 to 11:30
Training. You are on the floor while the camp trains. Watch the first block, run a station in the second
11:30 to 12:30
Break and lunch with the camp. Then your questions, while the players watch their film
12:30 to 14:00
The coaching. You take a team in the camp games, with feedback after every game
14:00 to 15:00
Upstairs, coaches only. What worked, and the plan for your own practice

Wednesday 30 is game day.

09:15
Coffee, then the warm up with the camp
10:30 to 14:00
Games. You coach a team, with feedback after every game. Fruit and snacks, no lunch
14:00 to 15:00
Upstairs, coaches only. The debrief with Deng and Tremaine

Real players in front of you

The players are our NBA and College Pathway Camp, ages 13 to 17. What you learn in the morning, you run with them that afternoon.

We coach the constraints-led way: small-sided games, guided discovery, less talking. You see it run, then you run it.

Who leads it

Deng Awak, Talata's Head Coach, runs both days with Tremaine Dalton, founder of The Process Basketball. Tremaine is camp director for the NBA Basketball Schools in Europe, technical director of the NBA Basketball School Portugal and a Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame nominee for the class of 2025.

He trains NBA and EuroLeague players. Mathias Lessort worked with him in Paris before winning the EuroLeague in 2024. More on Tremaine.

Questions coaches ask

Can my club pay?

Yes. We send the invoice to the club.

Do I need a børneattest?

To run a team, yes. The campers are 13 to 17. We request it after you book. Coaching from abroad? You watch, run a station with our coaches and join the 14:00 hour.

What if Tremaine cannot travel?

Deng runs both days, and anyone who wants their money back gets it.

What do I bring?

Indoor shoes, a notebook and your questions. Coffee, lunch on Tuesday and the camp t-shirt come from us.

What language?

English, both days.

Book a seat

30 places. Send your name, club and phone. Deng confirms your seat and sends the payment details.
